user.title: Add an HTBW room
user.description: Configure how this room participates in HTBW. Choose the room and, if applicable, its voice input and spoken response output. You can add an interface or physical remote afterward from this integration's options.

error.area_not_found: The selected room could not be found.

init.title: Room interaction functions
init.description: Update which native Home Assistant entity or device fulfills each interaction function for this room. Clear a field to remove that assignment.

missing_reference.title: A configured HTBW reference no longer exists
missing_reference.description: The {function} assignment for "{entry_title}" refers to {reference_id}, which no longer exists in Home Assistant. HTBW will not search for a replacement. Open this integration's configuration and choose a new reference, or remove the assignment.
